rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for something that is not suitable or not right.

example.english: This shirt is unsuitable for me.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 ngo5 zoek6 soeng5 san1 m4 ngaam1

rows.note: Use this when you want to state explicitly that a person, thing, or activity is unsuitable for a particular purpose or situation.

example.english: This course is unsuitable for beginners.
example.traditional: 呢個課程唔適合初學者。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 m4 sik1 hap6 co1 hok6 ze2
